about: Which non-MusicBrainz sites have pageTypes (PT) and link previews (POH), and where links inside a preview window open. Source of NON-MB-COVERAGE.html and NON-MB-COVERAGE.org, both written by scripts/build-coverage-report.py, which also checks every site, PT and reader here against ShowAllEntityData.user.js. Edit this file, then run the script; never edit the generated files. See org/non-MB-coverage.org.

notes.n1: On its own site a detail link opens in the site's own window; it needs that site's preview switch (Brucebase shows also sa_bb_event_preview).
notes.n2: Needs sa_pop_mb (Preview linked entities on hover). Off musicbrainz.org it is MusicBrainz's window read from the other site (dg-mb): its Web Service request anonymous, its Live page and editing history with the browser's musicbrainz.org cookies (vzell's consent: discogs.com and setlist.fm, then on 2026-11-03 the Springsteen sites and archive.org).
notes.n3: setlist, artist and venue pages need sa_pop_ext_setlistfm_key; without it only /search?artist= is read, and on setlist.fm itself the others keep their new tab.
notes.n4: On discogs.com a Discogs page no reader takes is the site's own link and keeps its new tab.
notes.n5: Brucebase's own reader, under sa_bb_event_preview; with it off, the generic reader's (then here only in a window that opens every link).
